orig_commit_message: [FLINK-37426][metrics] Refactoring to avoid code duplication in reporter setup code
improved_commit_message: Refactored reporter setup structures to use a builder pattern.
change_summary: This change introduces a new `ReporterSetupBuilder` class for creating reporter setups, streamlining the instantiation process. The old `ReporterSetup` and `TraceReporterSetup` classes were refactored to utilize this builder, enhancing code modularity and readability.
hints: Created a new class, `ReporterSetupBuilder`, to encapsulate the setup logic for reporters.
Refactored existing `ReporterSetup` and `TraceReporterSetup` classes to extend a common base class, `AbstractReporterSetup`, allowing for reuse of common functionality.
Updated all references in the codebase to utilize the new builder methods for creating reporter setups.
Ensured proper configuration loading through the new builder, reducing redundancy in reporter setup instantiation.

orig_commit_message: [FLINK-36706][table] Refactor TypeInferenceExtractor for PTFs
improved_commit_message: Refactor Type Inference Extraction for Flink Functions and Procedures
change_summary: Enhanced type inference extraction for various Flink user-defined and built-in functions, including additional features for state handling and argument traits. Improved handling of function hints and validation for argument types, including static arguments. Ensured backward compatibility with existing codebase while extending functionalities.
hints: Introduced StaticArgument and StateTypeStrategy to define static parameters and state management for Flink functions.
Refactored TypeInferenceExtractor to support ProcessTableFunction and integrate state management efficiently.
Updated test cases to cover new argument traits, static arguments, and state entries.
Validated the handling of state hints and their integration into type inference checks.
Utilized EnumSet for argument traits to streamline the definition of function behaviors.

orig_commit_message: [FLINK-36158][runtime] Refactor Job Recovery Process to Use ExecutionPlan Instead of JobGraph.
improved_commit_message: Refactor JobGraph to ExecutionPlan across the codebase
change_summary: This commit updates the project to replace instances of JobGraph with ExecutionPlan, reflecting a shift towards more reliable and flexible execution plans for job management. It involves changing references, method signatures, and associated documentation.
hints: Updated configuration options from job graphs to execution plans.
Renamed all JobGraph related classes and methods for consistency.
Changed the way job resource requirements are stored and retrieved to work with ExecutionPlans instead of JobGraphs.
Ensured backward compatibility by deprecating old methods.
Updated unit tests and integration tests to reflect changes from JobGraph to ExecutionPlan.

orig_commit_message:
[FLINK-36064][runtime] Refactor REST API for Client and Operator Coordinator Communication to Use operatorUid.

This commit modifies the REST API for communication between clients and operator coordinators by removing the dependency on operatorID and transitioning to a client-defined String operatorUid.

This closes #25227.
improved_commit_message: Refactor operator identification swapping OperatorID with operatorUid
change_summary: Changed the operator identification mechanism from OperatorID to operatorUid throughout the codebase for better clarity and identification on the client side. This change improves the handling of operator requests without relying on internal runtime concepts.
hints: Replaced OperatorID parameters in various methods with String operatorUid.
Modified comments and documentation to reflect the new identification approach.
Refactored test cases to use operatorUid instead of OperatorID.

orig_commit_message:
[FLINK-25920] Refactor & Revise SinkWriterOperatorTestBase

The stateful SinkWriterOperatorTestBase test cases used EOI to manipulate the state which was never clean. In particular, it also stored the input elements in state until EOI arrived and emitted them all at once. For state restoration tests, we emitted records after EOI arrived.

This commit changed the writer state completely to just capture the record count, which is much more realistic than storing actual payload. The tests now directly assert on the state instead of output.

This commit also introduces an adaptor for serializing basic types in the writer state and replaces the hard-to-maintain SinkAndSuppliers with an InspectableSink in the sink writer tests that require an abstraction on top of the different Sink flavors.
improved_commit_message: Refactor TestSink to use SimpleVersionedSerializerAdapter and clean up legacy code.
change_summary: Updated TestSink imports and constructors to utilize SimpleVersionedSerializerAdapter. Removed deprecated serializers. Improved clarity and maintainability of sink testing by adapting to new serializer structure.
hints: Replaced StringCommittableSerializer and other deprecated serializers with SimpleVersionedSerializerAdapter.
Modified tests to accommodate the new serializers, ensuring backwards compatibility where necessary.
Consolidated helper methods to streamline the creation of TestSink instances.

improved_commit_message: Refactor configuration access to use ConfigOption methods for consistency
change_summary: Updated configuration access in various classes to use new helper methods for fetching values using ConfigOption. This improves readability and consistency in how configuration values are handled across the codebase.
hints: Replaced calls to configuration.getInteger(key, default) with configuration.get(getIntConfigOption(key), default)

Utilized new methods for getLongConfigOption and getDoubleConfigOption in relevant places

KeyDefaultTypeDescription
execution.checkpointing.storage
(none)StringThe checkpoint storage implementation to be used to checkpoint state.
The implementation can be specified either via their shortcut name, or via the class name of a CheckpointStorageFactory. If a factory is specified it is instantiated via its zero argument constructor and its CheckpointStorageFactory#createFromConfig(ReadableConfig, ClassLoader) method is called.
Recognized shortcut names are 'jobmanager' and 'filesystem'.
'execution.checkpointing.storage' and 'execution.checkpointing.dir' are usually combined to configure the checkpoint location. By default, the checkpoint meta data and actual program state will be stored in the JobManager's memory directly. When 'execution.checkpointing.storage' is set to 'jobmanager', if 'execution.checkpointing.dir' is configured, the meta data of checkpoints will be persisted to the path specified by 'execution.checkpointing.dir'. Otherwise, the meta data will be stored in the JobManager's memory. When 'execution.checkpointing.storage' is set to 'filesystem', a valid path must be configured to 'execution.checkpointing.dir', and the checkpoint meta data and actual program state will both be persisted to the path.
execution.checkpointing.dir
(none)StringThe default directory used for storing the data files and meta data of checkpoints in a Flink supported filesystem. The storage path must be accessible from all participating processes/nodes(i.e. all TaskManagers and JobManagers). If the 'execution.checkpointing.storage' is set to 'jobmanager', only the meta data of checkpoints will be stored in this directory.
execution.checkpointing.savepoint-dir
(none)StringThe default directory for savepoints. Used by the state backends that write savepoints to file systems (HashMapStateBackend, EmbeddedRocksDBStateBackend).
execution.checkpointing.cleaner.parallel-mode
trueBooleanOption whether to discard a checkpoint's states in parallel using the ExecutorService passed into the cleaner
execution.checkpointing.incremental
falseBooleanOption whether to create incremental checkpoints, if possible. For an incremental checkpoint, only a diff from the previous checkpoint is stored, rather than the complete checkpoint state. Once enabled, the state size shown in web UI or fetched from rest API only represents the delta checkpoint size instead of full checkpoint size. Some state backends may not support incremental checkpoints and ignore this option.
execution.checkpointing.local-backup.dirs
(none)StringThe config parameter defining the root directories for storing file-based state for local recovery. Local recovery currently only covers keyed state backends. If not configured it will default to <WORKING_DIR>/localState. The <WORKING_DIR> can be configured via process.taskmanager.working-dir
execution.checkpointing.local-backup.enabled
falseBooleanThis option configures local backup for the state backend, which indicates whether to make backup checkpoint on local disk. If not configured, fallback to execution.state-recovery.from-local. By default, local backup is deactivated. Local backup currently only covers keyed state backends (including both the EmbeddedRocksDBStateBackend and the HashMapStateBackend).
execution.checkpointing.num-retained
1IntegerThe maximum number of completed checkpoints to retain.

orig_commit_message: [FLINK-35533][runtime] Refactor the APIs and implementations for supporting remote tier plugin
improved_commit_message: Refactor NettyShuffleServiceFactory to improve partition handling with Tiered Storage.
change_summary: This commit refactors the NettyShuffleServiceFactory to enhance the way shuffle partitions are created and managed when using tiered storage. The changes simplify the input parameters for constructors and methods, focusing on better handling of shuffle descriptors and improving overall code clarity. The motivation behind this refactoring is to make the code more maintainable and adaptable for future enhancements in the shuffle service architecture.
hints: Replaced ShuffleMasterContext configuration retrieval with improved context handling in NettyShuffleMaster.
Introduced clear separation of concerns between different storage tiers and their corresponding memory specifications.
Consolidated the number of parameters passed down to constructors and methods for better readability.

+}

[hotfix][runtime] Refactors suspend and cancel logic

suspend and cancel reset the ExecutionGraph in a similar way. I move the common logic into its own method to make this more prominent in the code.
improved_commit_message: Refactor job vertex cancellation and suspension logic for improved clarity and reusability
change_summary: The cancellation and suspension procedures for execution job vertices have been refactored to utilize a more generic method, reducing code duplication and enhancing maintainability. The new approach applies functions to each job vertex asynchronously, streamlining the control flow and making it easier to apply additional operations in the future.
hints: Created a private method 'resetExecutionGraph' to handle the cancellation and suspension logic more generically.
Replaced multiple CompletableFuture handling for job vertices with a streamlined 'applyToVertexAsync' method.
Removed reliance on ConjunctFuture by using CompletableFuture directly, simplifying the async management.

improved_commit_message: Refactor window assigners: Replace WindowAssigner with GroupWindowAssigner
change_summary: This refactor updates various classes to utilize GroupWindowAssigner instead of the legacy WindowAssigner. The changes encapsulate the transition to a new windowing model that aligns with the evolving Flink API for handling group windows, enhancing clarity and consistency in window operations.
hints: Replaced occurrences of WindowAssigner with GroupWindowAssigner across multiple classes and methods.
Adjusted triggers and internal window processing to support the new GroupWindowAssigner.
Updated related test cases to ensure the new behavior aligns with expected outcomes.

+package org.apache.flink.table.runtime.operators.window;
+
+import javax.annotation.Nullable;
+
+/**
+ * Callback to be used in when merging slices or windows for specifying which slices or windows
+ * should be merged.
+ *
+ * @param <W> The type {@link Window} for windows or the type {@link Long} for slices that this
+ *     callback used to merge.
+ * @param <R> The result type like {@link java.util.Collection} or {@link Iterable} to specify which
+ *     slices or windows should be merged.
+ */
+public interface MergeCallback<W, R> {
